## IInferSchemaKey type

Key type inferred from a schema class's `key` builder.

**Signature:**

```typescript
type IInferSchemaKey<C extends IAnyColumnBuilder> = C extends IColumnBuilder<infer K, IColumnIndexFlag, string | undefined, infer V, boolean> ? ITsKind<K, V> : never;
```
**References:** [IAnyColumnBuilder](./lmdb.ianycolumnbuilder.md)<!-- -->, [IColumnBuilder](./lmdb.icolumnbuilder.md)<!-- -->, [IColumnIndexFlag](./lmdb.icolumnindexflag.md)

## Remarks

Gives the key VALUE type (`bigint` for `key: t.bigint()`<!-- -->), usable as `KeyOf<S>`<!-- -->'s key parameter. Prefer the short alias [KeyOf](./lmdb.keyof.md) (`KeyOf<typeof UserSchema>`<!-- -->) — it intersects with `ILmdbKey` exactly like the runtime [LmdbEnv.register()](./lmdb.lmdbenv.register.md) overload does.
